observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: dance studio with wooden floors, white walls, and mirrors
observation.dancers: group of about 10-12 female dancers and one male instructor
observation.formation_and_space: group in loose rows facing mirrors, moving around the studio space
observation.posture: slightly forward-leaning torso with bent knees and grounded weight
observation.footwork: energetic bouncing stepping pattern with high knee lifts on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms moving dynamically overhead and to the sides, hands open
observation.hips_and_torso: bouncing torso with subtle hip movements matching the rhythm
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent high jumps, low squats, and traveling turns
observation.costume_and_props: casual dance attire including tank tops, leggings, shorts, and wrap skirts
observation.cannot_infer: exact percussion drum names other than djembe; acoustic details of room echo

signature_moments.what: Dancers bounce on alternate feet while lifting knees high and swinging arms overhead.
Instructor leaps across the floor with high leg extensions and energetic arm sweeps.
Dancers travel diagonally while maintaining a high-energy high-knee bounce.
Instructor drops into a deep squat and rises rapidly into an explosive leap.
